global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, cloudy broth, topped with chashu pork, nori, and naruto fish cake. Served in a patterned bowl, it rests on a dark wooden table under warm, focused lighting.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and warm light reflection near left edge.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with geometric and circular patterns in brown and green, featuring a raised, decorated rim.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles appears golden-brown, rich, and slightly cloudy, with visible noodles and green onions floating within.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible surface wrinkles and slight curling edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, marbled texture with golden-brown sear and visible fat layers on its curved surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: round, pale yellow with pink swirl, smooth surface, slightly translucent, showing layered interior.
